summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing a digital-asset treasury reallocation. On September 29, 2026, the company sold its entire Solana position and part of its Bitcoin holdings, using proceeds to buy roughly 38,102 Hyperliquid (HYPE) tokens. Post-trade holdings total approximately 232,900 HYPE, valued near US$20.1 million. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, premium or closing date is stated. This is a routine treasury-management update, not a special situation; watch HYPE price volatility and disclosure of future treasury shifts.
